theme.name: Monetta Web F1 borrador sin publicar 2026-10-19

checks.name: product-initial: captured (product page, JavaScript on, nothing pending)
product-pending: captured (a choice waiting for Shopify: status text, buttons disabled, chip and header value agree)
product-failed: captured (the choice failed: chips back on the shown variant, message names both options)
product-no-js: captured (JavaScript disabled: the options are links, the first one current)
product-no-js-soldout: captured (JavaScript disabled, sold-out variant reached through its link)
listing-load-failure: captured (load more failed: retry button and a separate link to the next page)
bag-initial: captured (bag with a personalised line)
bag-change-pending: captured (a quantity change on the wire: every checkout button disabled)
bag-unconfirmed: captured (the change failed and the bag could not be read back: notice with "Actualizar bolsa", checkout disabled)
bag-undo-toast: captured (line removed: the "Deshacer" toast (it restores the personalised line))
search-empty: captured (no results, before pressing "Editar búsqueda")
search-edit-focused: captured (after "Editar búsqueda": the visible field is focused with its text selected)
